authority: Pass456 R2C canonical table/query ownership enforcement (extends Pass450 R0)

rules.inline_sql: Operational SQL embedded in Go adapters is scanned; sqlc/query-file ownership alone is insufficient.
rules.known_open: Known-open violations remain failures in strict mode; --allow-known-open exists only for R0 guard self-validation.
rules.migration: Every production CREATE TABLE must be represented exactly once and point to its creating migration.
rules.read: Reads must originate from an allowed owner/application adapter path.
rules.write: Only owner write paths or explicit narrow write_exceptions may mutate a canonical table.

write_exceptions.reason: Player Core owns the first_entry_pending lifecycle bit stored on the bootstrap player root; query is column-bounded.
Player Core service persists first_entry_pending through the I5 owner store; retained as an explicit column-level ownership exception.
